title: Mark Hirsh Gecker - Communication April 22 From The Netherlands Consulate-General

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Branch Station//
REPORT
Date May 6, 19 38.
Subject M. H. Gecker: communication dated April 22 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General.
Made by D.S. Larby    Forwarded by C. Crawford

With reference to the attached letter from the
Netherlands Consulate-General regarding one, Mark Hirsh
Gecker, a Russian Jew, who has applied for a visa for
admission into the Netherlands Indies; enquiries have
failed to yield any information which is in the least way
detrimental to this individual who is an enthusiastic young
athlete, well recommended by the officials of the Foreign
Y.M.C.A. of which institution he is an active member.
As mentioned in the attached communication, Gecker
is in possession of a Certificate of Registration No.22307
issued by the Commissioner of Police of Greater Shanghai
on July 19, 1937 and a certificate of Registration No. 514
issued by the French Police at Shanghai on January 26,
1938. According however to the records of the Russian
Emigrants' Association with which body he is registered,
Gecker was born in Melitople on September 9, 1916 and not
on January 15, 1917 as stated on the aforementioned
certificates.
For some time past, Gecker who is a trained radio
telegraphist, has been without regular employment and due
to these circumstances he had intended to proceed to the
Netherlands Indies with the object of selling cotton piece
goods. Accompanying him would have been a German, one
Mordka Knopf, an individual of Polish and Jewish extraction,
whose behaviour on occasion suggests that he is mentally
unbalanced. In view of the uncertainty regarding the time
which he would have been permitted to remain in the
Netherlands Indies, Gecker has cancelled his previous

报告
日期 1938年5月6日。
事由 M. H. Gecker：荷兰总领事馆4月22日来函。
呈报人 D.S. Larby    转呈人 C. Crawford

关于随函附上的荷兰总领事馆来信，涉及一名名为 Mark Hirsh Gecker 的俄罗斯犹太人，其已申请进入荷属东印度的签证；经查询，未发现任何对该人不利的信息。此人是一名热情的年轻运动员，得到其积极所属的外国青年会（Foreign Y.M.C.A.）官员的良好推荐。
正如所附信函中所述，Gecker 持有大上海警察局局长于1937年7月19日签发的第22307号登记证，以及上海法租界巡捕房于1938年1月26日签发的第514号登记证。然而，根据其注册所在的俄国侨民协会的记录，Gecker 于1916年9月9日出生于梅利托波尔（Melitople），而非上述证书中所称的1917年1月15日。
Gecker 是一名受过训练无线电报务员，近一段时间以来一直无固定工作，鉴于此情况，他原打算前往荷属东印度销售棉布匹货。同行者将有一名德国人，名为 Mordka Knopf，系波兰裔犹太人，其行为偶尔显示其精神失衡。鉴于其在荷属东印度获准停留的时间存在不确定性，Gecker 已取消先前的

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1185.    SHANGHAI,    22nd April 1938.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mark Hirsh GECKER has
applied to this Consulate General for a visé for admission into
the Netherlands Indies.

Gecker is in possession of a Certificate of Registration
No.22307 issued by the Commissioner of Police of the Government
of Greater Shanghai on the 19th July 1937 and a Certificate of
Registration No.514 issued by the French Police at Shanghai on
the 26th January 1938.

According to these certificates Gecker was born at Melitople
(Ukraine) on January 15, 1917, his profession is stated to be a
radio telegraphist.

In 1924 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin. During his
sojourn at Shanghai he has been lately employed by the United
Press as a radio telegraphist.

He intends to travel to the Netherlands Indies in company of
a German Jew Mr. Knopf, who arrived at Shanghai some time ago
from Manila and who will visit the Netherlands Indies to sell
silk goods etc. He resides at 66 Route Lorton No.19.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this person
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Consul General.

D. S. Lardy
（批：C 2/）

S'
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 27 APR. 1938）

DBP
（批：29/）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号1185。    上海，    1938年4月22日。

先生：

谨通知您，Mark Hirsh GECKER 已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

Gecker 持有大上海政府警察局局长于1937年7月19日签发的第22307号登记证，以及上海法国巡捕房于1938年1月26日签发的第514号登记证。

根据这些证书，Gecker 于1917年1月15日出生于梅利托波尔（乌克兰），职业注明为无线电报务员。

他于1924年从哈尔滨抵达上海。在上海逗留期间，他最近受雇于合众社（United Press）担任无线电报务员。

他计划与一位犹太裔德国人 Knopf 先生一同前往荷属东印度，后者不久前从马尼拉抵达上海，并将前往荷属东印度销售丝绸商品等。他居住在乐通路（Route Lorton）66号19室。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，

您顺从的仆人，

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科
副督察长

总领事。

D. S. Lardy
（批注：C 2/）

S'
（印章：上海公共租界工部局特务科 1938年4月27日）

DBP
（批注：29/）

May 7 38.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge
receipt of your communication No.1185 dated 22nd
April, 1938, and in reply have to inform you that
there is nothing in Police records detrimental to
the character of Mark Hirsh Gecker. A copy of
report is enclosed.

（批：Enclosed 7/5）
（批：764）

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

（批注：附件 5月7日）
（批注：764）

谨致
敬礼，

您顺从的仆人，

(签名) K. M. Bourne.
副督察长
（特务科）

荷兰驻上海总领事，
上海。
